summary: The agent failed the verifier despite producing what appeared to be correct outputs. The trace shows the agent used queue-capacity-planning skill for a welding/manufacturing capacity task, which is appropriate domain adaptation. However, the failure suggests the output didn't match verifier expectations exactly - likely header naming, column ordering, or summary format constraints. The agent also made a critical error: it showed negative backlog values propagating indefinitely (-71.19, -191.19, ... -5591.19) which violates the skill's own rule to clamp display values to zero. The skill needs clearer guidance on: (1) when domain adaptation requires header changes vs using exact task-specified headers, (2) enforcing max(0, queue) for ALL display columns not just one, (3) validating summary format against exact verifier requirements before declaring success, and (4) recognizing that manufacturing/welding domains may have different capacity calculations (30 hrs/day × 6 days = 180, not 168).
